review_candidates.title: Sr. Software Test Engineer – Networking & Protocols .(Python)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key requirements include Python test automation framework development, Wireshark/tcpreplay, Napatech or comparable SmartNIC hardware, Bamboo, Docker, Ansible/Terraform, and C/C++ codebase understanding. What you will need: Advanced Python scripting - building and maintaining test automation frameworks (not just writing scripts): reusable test libraries, fixtures, and CI-integrated suites. Test case design and defect tracking (Jira) - clear, reproducible bug reports and maintained regression suit
eligibility_evidence: EgyBell is hiring a Test Engineer for a multinational telecommunications company.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience testing network traffic, validate protocol behavior, and build automated test frameworks for functional, regression, and performance testing. Key requirements include Python test automation framework development, Wireshark/tcpreplay, Napatech or comparable SmartNIC hardware, Bamboo, Docker, Ansible/Terraform, and C/C++ codebase understanding. Ability to translate technical specifications and requirements into test plans that catch edge cases before release. 6 to 8 years of experience as a Test Engineer or in a similar position Preferred qualifications: Exposure to telecom/network protocol domain work and experience with mobile core network signaling protocols across 2G/3G/4G (SS7/MAP, Diameter, GTP-C/GTP-U).
